Trump made many claims while on the campaign trail.
U.S. President-elect Donald Trump made many claims on the campaign trail while seeking the nation's highest office again.
We looked into many of them, like whether Trump took credit for overturning Roe v.
Wade (true) or if whether said he plans to cut Medicare and Social Security if reelected (mixture).
Some of the claims Trump made that we've fact-checked involved his Democratic opponent, Vice President Kamala Harris.
One such claim was that Harris had backed out of a Sept. 4 Fox News debate with Trump (false), while another was that Harris "doesn't want anybody saying Merry Christmas" (false).
